title: Bolt Cam
description: A bolt cam hurls an ultra-high-speed camera along a crash rig toward an impact, then freezes. The punch is physical translation on a rail or pneumatic throw, not a change of focal length.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: The camera itself is the strike. Sports packages and music-video violence use it when contact has to be felt as a mass arriving, not as a tighter crop.
Near objects smear; the last frames can lock on the hit. Do not use it for a thought.
A realization wants a push or a crash zoom. A bolt cam that never hits anything is just a fast dolly with no grammar.

sections.title: How it works

blocks.text: The body rides a crash rail, wire, or robotic throw aimed at a pad, a body, or a ball. Shutter is high; speed is tens of meters per second, then a hard stop or a programmed settle.
Parallax is violent because the nodal point really moves. Prompt a bolt-cam strike toward [Subject], ultra-high-speed camera on a crash rig, the lens hurled at an impact then freezing.

sections.title: When to use it

blocks.text: Use it when impact is the beat: a punch, a kick, a crash test, a chorus hit. Do not use it as decoration on a wide that never meets a surface.

sections.title: Compared with similar shots

blocks.text: A Crash Zoom In is optical: the camera stays put and focal length snaps. Bolt cam translates.
An FPV Drone flies and can miss; this is a aimed throw on a rig. A Robo Arm can repeat a path without the crash energy.

sections.title: What usually goes wrong

blocks.text: The usual wrong cousin is a crash zoom. The tell: no parallax, the background simply enlarges.
The fix: demand body travel on a crash rig, smear in the near plane, then a settle at contact.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is Bolt Cam in film?
A bolt cam is an ultra-high-speed camera thrown on a crash rig toward an impact, then stopped. The lens physically travels; the hit is the end of the move.
Bolt Cam vs Crash Zoom In
A crash zoom changes focal length on a locked body. A bolt cam moves the camera through space at high speed, so near objects shear before the freeze.
When should I use Bolt Cam?
Use it when the camera is the punch: contact, a stunt, a chorus impact. Do not use it for a quiet close-up.
How do I prompt Bolt Cam for AI image or video?
Write a crash-rig strike and a freeze. Example: Bolt-cam strike toward [Subject], ultra-high-speed camera on a crash rig, the lens hurled at an impact then freezing.
